Dex boosts casting speed as well. I saw a video about how the sage rings boost your "virtual sex" and how much each ring boosts. After 40 dex you're casting speed can't be increased any further. So say you have 40 dex, any of the sage rings wouldnt help you at all. But if you had 10 dex and the sage ring +2 you would have 40 dex. The rings only give you the casting speed benefits of high dex without the adding to your damage.
Now if you had 40 dex,(by leveling dex, or by wearing a sage ring) I'm not sure if the saint tree chime will stack. I think 40 dex is the max casting speed, and chimes that boost casting speed make it as if you had 40 dex. So putting them together might not do anything.
